name: Osman Gourmet Restaurant
desc: Inexpensive family-friendly restaurant.

name: Karadeniz Aile Pide ve Kebap Salonu
desc: Their specialty is pide.

name: Meşhur Pideci Orhan Usta
desc: Welcoming small restaurant, good value.

name: Pak Pide Pizza Salonu
desc: Relaxing place for traditional pide.

name: Ali Usta Çiğ Köfte
desc: Good value Çiǧ köfte (spicy wrap with a vegan tatar) takeaway. Ali the owner is an instagram celeb for his videos jibing customers, so you may be in a long line.

name: Efsane Kahvaltı
desc: Great place for breakfast in a non-touristy area.

name: Buyruk Esnaf Lokantası
desc: A place that serves home-made style foods ("ev yemekleri") which you can order from the counter. Great variety.

name: Doy Doy Restaurant
desc: Cafe spread over three floors and a roof terrace with views over the sea and Blue Mosque. Good range of Turkish meals and mezes, with veggie choices.

name: Palatium Cafe & Restaurant
desc: Decent trad food and ice cold beer. Lounge in the comfy bean-bag chairs, and backgammon and Nargileh are available. The restaurant looks down into the foundations of a Roman-era palace.

name: Cafe Amedros
desc: Good Ottoman cuisine with veggie and GF choices.

name: Rumeli Restaurant
desc: Not cheap, but good value for its Ottoman and Turkish cuisine, service and vibe.

name: Korecan
desc: Good Korean cuisine.

name: Virginia Angus Steakhouse
desc: Steaks, burgers and similar.

name: Burgerillas
desc: Decent burgers, sit in or take away. They have ten other city locations.

name: Changcheng
desc: Good Chinese food.

name: Olden 1772
desc: A trip in both history and gastronomy.

name: Sarayburnu Aile Çay Bahçesi
desc: Open-air cafe on the coast with great views, though the park is grubby. Tea, coffee and many flavours of hubble-bubble.

name: Anadolu Nargile
desc: Shisha / hookah cafe in the courtyard of the former Çorlulu Ali Paşa Medrese, so plenty of Ottoman ambience.

name: Vefa Bozacısı

name: Bereket Döner
price: 13-23 TL for a full meal; can be substan

name: Şampiyon Kokoreç
desc: A restaurant mostly focused in kokoreç — roasted and finely minced lamb intestines (yeap). It tastes great and is very budget-friendly: only 10 TL/wrap. Try stuffed mussels as well.

name: İbrahim Hakkı Uğrak Börek
desc: A bit off the tourist track, the stone oven of this börek shop gives its products a distinctive flavour. Good value and friendly staff. Opens early, but not all varieties of börek will be ready first thing in the morning

name: Degustasyon Restaurant
desc: The restaurant is meyhane style, where lively conversation is the main dish on every table, next to fish and Rakı. A lot of negative reviews.

name: Ficcin
price: Around 20 TL per person without wine

name: Nevizade Street
desc: One of the most famous streets in Istiklal boulevard. It's narrow, and is mostly known for its meyhane style restaurants, where lively conversation is the main dish on every table, next to fish and Rakı that is.

name: Haci Abdullah Lokantası
addr: Ağa Camii, Atıf Yılmaz Caddesi (Eski Sakizagaci Caddesi) No: 9/A
desc: One of the best Ottoman restaurants in the country. You can find very traditional foods there. No alcohol.

name: Leb-i Derya
desc: A nice cafe-restaurant with a splendid view of the Bosphorus and the Topkapi Palace in Tunel, Beyoglu.

name: The House Café
desc: They serve giant salads, main dishes and pizzas pleasing even to the gourmets. The menu is seasonal which allows them to use only the freshest ingredients.

name: Miss Pizza Sishane
desc: Very cozy Italian restaurant run by three women serving pizza, pasta, and salads.

name: Privato
desc: Traditional Turkish food with a focus on vegetarian dishes. Great for breakfast. Has a small patio in the back with a view of the Galata tower.

name: Zeytuna

name: 360 Istanbul
desc: Great reviews for this rooftop restaurant with panoramic views.

name: Riddim Club Taksim
desc: A complex with three floor. Rıddim live is the performance hall of complex and you can listen rock pop and alternative kinds of music. Riddim Special is the conceptual parties floor. İstanbul's best R&B-HipHop club is Rı

name: Mektup Bar
desc: Authentic live music. But, there is a restaurant, too. Do expect to pay a cover charge (approximately 15 TL) if there is a band playing.

name: Montreal Nevizade
desc: Located in Nevizade where you can see so many small bars located next to each other, has live music and beer and shots in a subdued ambience of neon lights.

name: Snog Rooftop Bar
desc: Good bar. But the attraction here is the stunning view.

name: Kadınlar Kahvesi
desc: Different types of traditional Turkish coffees and snacks.

name: Sultana's Dinner and 1001 Nights Show
desc: In Elmadag, near Taksim, has traditional Turkish cuisine (meze, kebabs, desserts) with a show every evening of belly dancing, Turkish folklore and live music.

name: Set Kebap
desc: Has a wonderful meze table and delicious Adana Kebab. The staff speaks very little English but are most anxious to be helpful.

name: Kosebasi Kebap
desc: This Zagat-rated kebab joint serves traditional Turkish kebabs in modern/ upscale atmosphere. Levent is the main branch but they have 7 more locations (including 3 express versions) in Istanbul.

name: Sosa
desc: Fairly priced salads and wraps among others.

name: Kristal Ocakbaşı
desc: Classic Turkish steak-house.

name: Maslak
desc: A neighborhood with dozens of luxury eateries, both in local and international fashion.

name: Levent
desc: A neighborhood which is just across the Sapphire of Istanbul and hosts nice bars.

name: Taps
desc: A bar, restaurant and brewery in one. The crowd is the general Nişantaşı crowd, it also attracts a lot of expatriates.

name: Akmanoğlu Fırını
desc: This is the bakery where halkas mentioned in the "See" section, as well as a number of other traditional cookies, both sweet and salty, are produced and sold.

name: Lale Lokantasi
desc: Traditional Turkish/Ottoman cuisine.

name: La Mekan
addr: Emniyettepe, Mareşal Fevzi Çakmak Cd. No:60 D:1
desc: Also a grill restaurant next door, Çınaraltı.

name: Pierre Loti

name: Yeşil Çiftlik Restaurant
addr: Kilyos Yolu Uskumruköy Kavsağı No:30 Sariyer/Istanbul
desc: Special lamb barbecue, kebabs, country breakfast, beer, rakı and other alcoholic drinks, Nargile (Waterpipe, Sheesha) available.

name: Vagabondo's Ristorante & Pizzeria
addr: Köybaşı Cad. Yalılar Durağı No: 168 Yeniköy / İstanbul
desc: Italian cuisine; pizza, steak, pasta, wines and other alcohol available.

name: Güzelyer Yedigün Balık Lokantasi
addr: Rumelikavagi karakutuk cad. No: 96 Tellibaba ustu, 34450 Sarıyer
desc: Great seafood restaurant at the cost.

name: Uzunya Beach Restaurant
desc: Cozy seafood restaurant at the Black Sea. Very popular for weekend breakfasts.

name: Sans
desc: Nice restaurant in a small garden serving Turkish and Mediterranean food.

name: Park Fora
addr: Muallim Naci Caddesi, Cemil Topuzlu Parkı
desc: Great seafood, located in Kuruçeşme park right on the edge of the sea, it has a very nice view of the Bosphorus and Bosphorus Bridge. The waiters know English.

name: Divan Brasserie Bebek
addr: Bebek, Cevdet Paşa Cd. No: 28/A, 34342 Beşiktaş
desc: At first sight it may seem like a mere patisserie, but walk downstairs and you will find a lovely restaurant with the waters of the Bosporus right next to you. The food is simply first-class and the service is very good,

name: Ulus 29
desc: Upscale restaurant with an amazing view over the Bosporus.

name: Kazan
desc: A quite elegantly decorated local pub in which fans of Beşiktaş FC that could not make it to the stadium, old and young, male and female, like to watch the games on live broadcast. During summer months, they also have an

name: Beyti
desc: Expensive and a bit of a way out, but its meat dishes draw consistently admiring reviews.

name: Yüksel Balık Lokantası
desc: Steep prices but great seafood. They'll advise on what is the best fish for the season and other dishes.
